about: At age 74 the patient received Demazin Original Cold + Flu Relief Day + Night by brand alone, which identifies chlorphenamine in the night tablets.
At age 67 the patient received Demazin Cold + Flu + Cough Day + Night in January 2026, which identifies chlorphenamine in the night tablets.
The plain Demazin Cold + Flu Relief pack contains only paracetamol and phenylephrine, and the other allergy tablets contain cetirizine.
